Morning. **Martin** here, delighted as ever to run down all the news you need
to start the week. Let us give thanks for this week's impending holiday, as
well as for the mandatory musical Monday
[selection](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c1GxjzHm5us).

In today's **' First Draft,'** we look at **Abdul El-Sayed 's** headline-
making suggestion that **Donald Trump** should partner with Democrats to pass
healthcare reform, painted gold and with Trump's name plastered all over it,
if that means the American people finally get the help they need. Trump
appeared to bite; Sunday show hosts pounced, and at least one Republican
seemed personally aggrieved. Which was fun.

In Seattle, a reality check. **ICE** agents violently took down a man and his
daughter as they tried to board a flight to LA. Condemnation was widespread,
but if ever an event seemed designed to show what two years of **Stephen
Miller 's** Trump administration will look like, this was it. There's also
more Iran war news and a blizzard of Trumpian corruption to keep up with. In
we go.

Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic senator-elect from Michigan, is shaking things
up on Capitol Hill - and [frightening the
](https://www.wsj.com/politics/abdul-el-sayed-is-already-shaking-up-the-
senate-72675805?mod=e2tw)_[Wall Street
Journal](https://www.wsj.com/politics/abdul-el-sayed-is-already-shaking-up-
the-senate-72675805?mod=e2tw)_ - even before he is sworn in.

On Sunday, the former public health official reached for a sports metaphor to
explain why he thinks Donald Trump might actually partner with Democrats on
root-and-branch healthcare reform, as the president
[suggested](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6233986-trump-open-
democrat-cooperation-healthcare/) in his rambling press conference Friday.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" Well, the president signaled openness to the opportunity, and I played
lacrosse growing up, and I was always taught that you play the ball, not the
man,"** El-Sayed told NBC's 'Meet the Press.'

El-Sayed wants to get the ball in the goal by using The Man. He set out his
idea as bait on social media, complete with an image of a gold TrumpCare card.

**" Donald, this is on the table,"** El-Sayed
[wrote](https://x.com/AbdulElSayed/status/2120938651358273723) on Nov. 12. **"
Guarantee health care for every American, from cradle to grave."**

Eventually, the big gold fish took the big gold bait.
